name: Porsche 911 RSR (2017)
weaknesses: Rear snap risk under trail braking
description: The legendary mid-engine flat-six racer that combines Porsche's racing heritage with modern performance. The 911 RSR's rear-mounted engine provides exceptional mid-corner grip and rear-end stability, making it a precision instrument in the right hands. With 510 horses and a perfect weight distribution, this machine has all the ingredients for championship success.

name: Porsche 911 GT3 R (992) '22
description: The cutting-edge evolution of Porsche's racing pedigree. The modern 911 GT3 R delivers contemporary performance wrapped in timeless sports car DNA. Its responsive steering and eager mid-corner rotation reward aggressive inputs, while the potent flat-six produces a distinctive howl through the rev range.

name: Ferrari 296 GT3
weaknesses: Aggressive tire wear under hard driving
description: The newest addition to Ferrari's GT3 arsenal. The 296 GT3 marries iconic Italian design with twin-turbo performance and pure racing passion. Its V6 turbo engine delivers exhilarating throttle response with intelligent power delivery and torque management.

name: Ferrari 458 Italia GT3
description: An iconic masterpiece from Maranello. The 458 Italia GT3 delivers authentic Prancing Horse passion with its naturally aspirated V8 and responsive steering. The raw engine note and immediate throttle response make it one of sim racing's most rewarding cars for smooth, committed drivers.

name: BMW M4 GT Endurance Model
weaknesses: Prone to understeer at corner entry
description: A powerhouse of Bavarian engineering. The BMW M4 GT Endurance delivers devastating straight-line speed with its twin-turbo inline-six. Despite its weight, the M4's sophisticated balance and responsive steering make it deceptively agile through technical sections.

name: Lamborghini Huracán GT3
description: A wild, aggressive Italian supercar bred for competition. The Huracán GT3 delivers visceral performance with its naturally aspirated V10 producing an unforgettable soundtrack. The mid-engine layout provides confident traction while the aggressive aero package generates serious downforce.

name: Toyota GR Supra Racing Concept
description: A lightweight, agile machine that rewards smooth inputs and precision over raw power. The GR Supra Racing Concept excels at extracting maximum pace through technical sections with minimal aggression. It demands respect, concentration, and mechanical sympathy.

name: Audi R8 LMS Evo '19
weaknesses: Lacks the outright speed of turbo rivals
description: A technically sophisticated racing instrument from Ingolstadt. The R8 LMS Evo combines a perfectly balanced chassis with responsive steering and consistent performance. In Luca Ascarelli's hands, the R8's balanced nature makes it a dominant force in the championship.

name: Nissan GT-R NISMO GT3
weaknesses: Heaviest FR car in the field
description: A legendary performance icon evolved into a formidable racing platform. The GT-R NISMO GT3 delivers confidence-inspiring traction and aggressive aerodynamics. Its turbocharged V6 produces massive torque that rewards commitment and bravery.

name: Lexus RC F GT3
description: A refined, elegant machine from Lexus. The RC F GT3 combines smooth naturally aspirated V8 power delivery with balanced handling and composure. Its sophisticated chassis tuning helps exploit any advantage in mixed conditions.

name: Dodge Viper GTS-R GT3
description: A brute-force American muscle car reimagined as a racing machine. The Viper GTS-R GT3's massive 8.4-litre V10 produces 645 HP and 820 Nm of torque — the most powerful and torquey car on the entire grid. Sean Corbin has tamed this beast into a championship-contending weapon.

name: Mazda RX-Vision GT3 Concept
strengths: Lightest car on the grid by far
weaknesses: Less stable at very high speed
description: The lightest car on the grid and the championship leader's weapon of choice. The RX-Vision GT3 Concept's 4-rotor Wankel engine and featherweight 1,100 kg chassis create a car that dances through corners. In Jeffery D'ornellas's hands, this underdog has become the most feared machine in the league — proof that driver skill conquers all.

name: Genesis X GR3
description: A stunning Vision Gran Turismo entry from Hyundai's luxury division. The Genesis X GR3 represents cutting-edge design and technology applied to GT racing. Its sleek aerodynamic profile and twin-turbo V6 provide smooth, responsive performance.

name: Renault R.S.01 GT3
description: A technically sophisticated French racing machine. The R.S.01 GT3 delivers responsive handling and eager mid-corner rotation wrapped in an angular, purposeful design. Cameron Browne's improving form suggests he's unlocking this machine's competitive potential.

name: Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution Final Edition Gr.3
description: The legendary Lancer Evolution reimagined as a GT3 competitor. The all-wheel drive system provides exceptional traction and confidence, especially in mixed conditions. While it lacks the raw power of some rivals, its predictable handling and mechanical grip make it a capable tool in skilled hands.
